title: COPR: Continual Human Preference Learning via Optimal Policy Regularization
authors_zh: Han Zhang 等（哈尔滨工业大学、鹏城实验室、伦敦国王学院等）
paper_type_zh: 持续偏好优化与策略正则化研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建持续接收偏好数据的对齐系统，并需在适应新任务时保留既有行为的读者。
one_line: COPR constrains continual preference updates with historical optimal-policy distributions so new feedback can be learned without collapsing earlier preferences.
COPR 用历史最优策略分布约束持续偏好更新，使模型学习新反馈时不至于遗忘或压扁早期偏好。
why: It makes the arrival order and historical consumption of preference data explicit components of the training objective.
inclusion_reason: It directly specifies how new preference records and historical preference information jointly enter an optimization objective over time.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Real alignment systems do not receive all preference data once. New tasks, users, and domains provide feedback over time, but repeatedly applying an offline preference objective to the newest batch can widen chosen-rejected probability gaps, reduce output diversity, and degrade earlier behavior. A static preference corpus hides this time-ordering problem.

COPR asks how newly arriving preference records can be consumed without treating historical preferences as disposable. The paper frames continual alignment as constrained optimization: new preference data must improve the current task while historical optimal policies define what the update should not forget. It is concerned with the training use of sequential feedback, not with constructing new preference labels.

真实对齐系统不会一次性获得全部偏好数据。新的任务、用户和领域会不断提供反馈，但若反复把离线偏好目标施加到最新批次，优劣回答概率差可能不断扩大，输出多样性降低，早期行为也会退化。静态偏好语料会掩盖这种时间顺序问题。

COPR 询问如何消费新到达的偏好记录，而不把历史偏好视为可丢弃的信息。论文把持续对齐表述为约束优化：新偏好数据必须改善当前任务，而历史最优策略定义更新不应遗忘的内容。它关注序列反馈的训练使用，而非构造新的偏好标签。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
COPR represents prior learning by historical optimal policies rather than by replaying a fixed raw-data pool alone. It derives a moderate reward from the pairwise ranking loss so that new training does not endlessly sharpen a preference gap. The resulting policy distributions become constraints on the next update, connecting the current task to a record of earlier optimization decisions.

This produces a compromise between new and old preference evidence. A Lagrangian-dual formulation balances the objective for the incoming task against the policy-regularization constraints, while the moderate reward is intended to preserve generation diversity. The important data-use change is that each new batch is evaluated in relation to the historical policies that previous batches produced.

COPR 用历史最优策略表示先前学习，而不只依赖重放固定的原始数据池。它从成对排序损失中推导出温和奖励，使新训练不会无止境地锐化偏好差。由此得到的策略分布成为下一次更新的约束，把当前任务与早期优化决策的记录连接起来。

这在新的和旧的偏好证据之间形成折中。拉格朗日对偶形式平衡新到任务的目标与策略正则化约束，温和奖励则旨在保留生成多样性。重要的数据使用变化是：每个新批次都要相对于早期批次所产生的历史策略来评估。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a sequence of preference tasks, COPR takes the current task's prompt-response comparisons and the historical optimal policies learned on preceding tasks. It converts the pairwise ranking signal into a moderate reward, parameterizes the sampling distributions associated with current and historical policies, and uses those distributions to form new learning objectives and constraints. A dual optimization procedure then updates the policy while enforcing the historical conditions.

The paper evaluates task-incremental and domain-incremental continual alignment. It compares COPR with continual-learning and iterative-alignment baselines using reward-based measures, GPT-4 evaluation, human assessment, and generation-diversity statistics. Reproduction needs the task order, task boundaries, preference-data versions, prior checkpoints or policy distributions, constraint weights, evaluation prompts, and the exact policy-update schedule; changing the order changes the learning problem.

对于一系列偏好任务，COPR 接收当前任务的提示—回答比较，以及在先前任务上学得的历史最优策略。它把成对排序信号转为温和奖励，对当前和历史策略相关的采样分布进行参数化，并用这些分布形成新的学习目标与约束。随后，对偶优化过程在满足历史条件的同时更新策略。

论文评测任务增量和领域增量的持续对齐。它用基于奖励的度量、GPT-4 评估、人工评估和生成多样性统计，与持续学习和迭代对齐基线比较。复现需要任务顺序、任务边界、偏好数据版本、先前检查点或策略分布、约束权重、评测提示和确切策略更新日程；改变顺序就改变了学习问题。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that COPR outperforms its compared continual-learning baselines in the proposed continual-alignment benchmark under reward-based metrics, GPT-4 evaluation, and human assessment. Its diversity analysis is central to the claim: the authors measure generation diversity alongside task performance because a method could preserve a reward score by collapsing to a narrow response style. The paper also supplies theoretical learnability analysis for the constrained formulation.

The evidence supports a narrower conclusion than universal continual alignment: under the reported task and domain sequences, historical-policy constraints can improve the balance of new-task adaptation, retention, and diversity relative to the baselines. It does not establish that policy distributions are sufficient summaries of all earlier human preferences, or that the same constraints resolve direct conflicts between old and new values. Those boundaries should remain visible when adapting the method.

论文报告，在所提出的持续对齐基准上，COPR 在基于奖励的度量、GPT-4 评估和人工评估中都优于比较的持续学习基线。多样性分析是其主张的核心：作者在任务表现之外测量生成多样性，因为一种方法可能通过坍缩到狭窄回答风格来维持奖励分数。论文还为约束形式提供理论可学习性分析。

证据支持的结论比普适持续对齐更窄：在所报告的任务和领域序列中，历史策略约束能相对于基线更好地平衡新任务适应、保持和多样性。它并未证明策略分布足以概括所有早期人类偏好，也未证明相同约束能解决新旧价值之间的直接冲突。改造方法时应保留这些边界。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Many continual-learning approaches preserve parameters, replay examples, or regularize outputs, while ordinary offline preference optimization treats the newest pairwise data as the main object. COPR changes the optimization record by promoting historical optimal-policy distributions to explicit constraints. The moderate reward also targets a failure mode specific to repeated preference optimization: excessive widening of the preferred-dispreferred gap and the resulting preference collapse.

The novelty is not that historical data matters, nor that constrained optimization and policy regularization exist. The reusable change is to derive a policy-level representation of earlier preference learning and use it as a formal condition for consuming the next batch. Before reuse, check how prior policies are stored or approximated, whether the constraints preserve harmful legacy behavior, and whether a benchmark's task order reflects the intended deployment stream.

许多持续学习方法保持参数、重放样本或正则化输出，而普通离线偏好优化把最新的成对数据视为主要对象。COPR 通过把历史最优策略分布提升为显式约束，改变了优化记录。温和奖励还针对重复偏好优化的特定失败模式：优劣回答差距过度扩大，以及由此导致的偏好坍缩。

新意并不在于历史数据重要，也不在于约束优化和策略正则化的存在。可复用的变化是推导出早期偏好学习的策略级表示，并把它作为消费下一批数据的正式条件。复用前，应检查先前策略如何被存储或近似、约束是否会保留有害的遗留行为，以及基准的任务顺序是否反映预期部署流。

title: Limitations
局限
html: COPR requires historical optimal-policy information and a choice of constraint strength, both of which can add storage, bookkeeping, and tuning burden as the task stream grows. Preserving old policies is not inherently desirable when old and new preferences conflict or when earlier labels contain harmful bias. The reported benchmark sequences may also be simpler than real feedback streams with drifting users, unclear task boundaries, and missing historical data. A deployment should test order sensitivity, subgroup behavior, old-new conflict cases, and the cost of retaining the necessary policy state.
COPR 需要历史最优策略信息和约束强度的选择；随着任务流增长，两者都可能增加存储、记账和调参负担。当新旧偏好冲突，或早期标签本身带有有害偏差时，保留旧策略并不天然合理。报告中的基准序列也可能比真实反馈流简单，后者会有不断变化的用户、不清晰的任务边界和缺失的历史数据。部署时应测试顺序敏感性、子群行为、新旧冲突情形及保留必要策略状态的成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use COPR when preference data arrives as an ordered sequence and the training objective must explicitly trade current adaptation against retained behavior. Treat the task order, historical-policy representation, and constraint coefficients as data-governance metadata, then report separate results on the current task, earlier tasks, diversity, and conflict cases. It is useful for continual alignment design, but not for a one-shot preference-training run where no historical behavior must be preserved.
当偏好数据以有序序列到达，且训练目标必须明确权衡当前适应与既有行为保持时，可使用 COPR。应把任务顺序、历史策略表示和约束系数当作数据治理元数据，并分别报告当前任务、早期任务、多样性和冲突情形的结果。它适合持续对齐设计，但不适用于无需保留历史行为的一次性偏好训练。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key note is that continual preference data is not only a larger dataset; its order changes the objective. COPR records that order through historical optimal policies and uses the policies to constrain each new update. Its evidence should be read with the diversity results, because retention of a scalar reward alone can hide preference collapse. The central reuse question is whether preserving the historical policy is aligned with the desired policy evolution, not merely whether it improves the final aggregate score.
关键笔记是：持续偏好数据不只是更大的数据集；其顺序会改变目标。COPR 通过历史最优策略记录这种顺序，并用这些策略约束每次新更新。阅读其证据时应结合多样性结果，因为仅保留标量奖励可能掩盖偏好坍缩。核心复用问题是保留历史策略是否符合期望的策略演化，而不只是它是否提高最终汇总分数。
